# Learning Principles

:::cdi-message
- **ID:** JIO-R04
- **Type:** Appendix
- **Audience:** Learners, Mentors, Communities
- **Theme:** Learning, Practice, Growth
:::

Jiongeze follows a simple approach:

## Learn

Build understanding.

## Practice

Apply what you learn.

## Create

Develop ideas and projects.

## Contribute

Help communities and others.

## Grow

Continue improving.

## Learning Cycle

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR

A[Learn]

A --> B[Practice]

B --> C[Create]

C --> D[Contribute]

D --> E[Grow]

E --> A
```

Learning continues throughout life.
